report_identity.report_title: Da Yu Financial Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Da Yu Financial Holdings provides Hong Kong corporate finance advisory, asset management, securities and related services including margin financing, and money lending.
segments: Corporate finance services, investment and others
business_overview.revenue_model: Advisory fees, asset management fees, securities brokerage/placing/underwriting and margin financing income, loan interest, and proprietary investment gains.
business_notes: Yu Ming is licensed for SFO Type 1, Type 4, Type 6 and Type 9 regulated activities.
Morton Securities is a Type 1/4/9 licensed securities dealer, exchange participant and CCASS direct clearing participant.
Morgan Finance holds a Hong Kong money lenders licence.
Margin financing business was activated in September 2025.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash goodwill impairment allocated to corporate finance services, investment and others unit.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 profit or loss statement and Note 16

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest income, dividend income and fair value gain including interest income on FVPL financial assets.

funds_assets.item: Cash on hand and at banks
funds_assets.business_substance: Group bank and cash balances excluding short-term time deposits.

funds_assets.item: Short-term time deposits with initial maturity within 3 months
funds_assets.business_substance: Cash equivalent time deposits with initial maturity within three months.
Segregated client monies arising from regulated securities business; restricted by client money rules and matched by client payables.

operating_assets.item: Trade and other receivables, deposits paid and prepayments
Amount due from a related company
operating_assets.business_substance: Trade in nature, unsecured and interest-free.
Interest-bearing margin financing receivable secured by pledged securities.
Hong Kong mortgage loan receivables from money lending business.

investment_assets.business_substance: Listed perpetual securities, listed debt and equity securities, and other unlisted financial instruments held by investment/securities businesses.

other_assets.business_substance: Goodwill from prior acquisition, after accumulated impairment.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 balance sheet and Note 16

other_assets.business_substance: Intangible assets related to acquired businesses.
Office premises leases used in operations.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Office lease liabilities, current and non-current.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables arising from ordinary securities dealing and brokerage services; includes segregated client deposit balances.
Advance consideration from customers before services are delivered.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 balance sheet and Note 31

years.source: Annual Report 2025 and Annual Report 2024 cash flow statements
Annual Report 2024 comparative cash flow statement

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year reported operating cash flow is highly volatile and negative in 2024 and 2025 because financial assets at FVPL, margin loans, client trust balances and securities payables move through operating cash flow. Use operating cash flow before working capital changes as support, then apply a conservative profit haircut.

evidence.source: IR Asia company financial reports page and PDF

evidence.value: restricted under SFO Client Money Rules
evidence.note: Client monies are held in segregated deposit accounts and matched by payables to clients.

evidence.value: HK$136.0m net proceeds; HK$116.0m intended for margin financing business
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 Management Discussion and Analysis, Use of Proceeds
evidence.note: Unutilised net proceeds at 31 December 2025 were HK$28.8m.

gaps: Cash and short-term time deposits are not fully split by parent company, regulated operating subsidiary and other subsidiaries.
FVPL financial assets are not disclosed security-by-security in the extracted fact pack, so liquidity and credit discounts use category-level assumptions.
Maintenance working capital requirement for regulated securities operations is not disclosed as a single line item.
